global_scope.sampling: Two deterministic outcome-independent days/month; not exhaustive global land

selection.criterion: Lebanese 2022 validation average precision; Brier breaks ties. Global validation changes and forgetting reported; no confirmation metric selects models.

refit.note: 2023-2025 source-site data are fit/calibration data for this refit, not its temporal holdout. New global 2026 is reserved. Lebanese 2026 is a repeated fixed-fold comparison, not newly independent.

paired_comparison.note: Diagnostic only; 15 positives and 10 months make inference unstable

global_2026_temporal.note: Conditional fitted-model interval; source/label uncertainty and incident dependence remain

lebanon_2026_fixed_fold.note: Conditional fitted-model interval; source/label uncertainty and incident dependence remain

release.note: Passing these checks is a minimum research-to-deployment gate, not a guarantee of emergency-warning reliability

limitations: Sampled global panels are not exhaustive global coverage
Global labels lack full FIRMS facility/conflict review; confidence/vegetation masks remain imperfect
2026 Lebanon masks lack original FIRMS type/confidence review available for older Lebanese labels
No incident-independent truth or historically issued weather evaluation
No confirmation metrics computed during preparation
Lebanese 2026 is a repeated pre-fixed comparison after the first benchmark, not a new independent test
The refit uses newer known years; old 2023-2025 temporal data cannot be called held out for this artifact
Historical weather reconstruction is not operational forecast validation

environment_recorded_after_fit.note: Runtime libraries remained unchanged; only project dependency metadata was rebuilt to declare SciPy directly and require sklearn neural sample-weight support.
